cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(MonakaVRInputProtocol LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(monaka_input_codec src/v2/codec.cpp)
add_library(MonakaVRInputProtocol::Codec ALIAS monaka_input_codec)
target_compile_features(monaka_input_codec PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(monaka_input_codec PUBLIC include PRIVATE third_party)
add_library(monaka_capabilities src/capabilities.cpp)
add_library(MonakaVRInputProtocol::Capabilities ALIAS monaka_capabilities)
target_link_libraries(monaka_capabilities PUBLIC monaka_input_codec)
target_include_directories(monaka_capabilities PUBLIC include)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(monaka_input_codec PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
  target_compile_options(monaka_capabilities PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
endif()
option(MVIP_BUILD_TESTS "Build isolated contract runners" OFF)
if(MVIP_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(mvip_codec_runner tests/runner_v2.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(mvip_codec_runner PRIVATE monaka_input_codec)
  add_test(NAME codec_atomicity COMMAND mvip_codec_runner --self-test)
  add_executable(mvip_capabilities_runner tests/capabilities_runner.cpp)
  target_include_directories(mvip_capabilities_runner PRIVATE third_party)
  target_link_libraries(mvip_capabilities_runner PRIVATE monaka_capabilities)
  add_test(NAME capability_set COMMAND mvip_capabilities_runner --self-test)
endif()
